raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 was re-delivered at 05:00 on 2026-01-18 with 698 rows, about double the normal ~345. The re-delivered rows are copies of rows from the 02:00 delivery with identical txn_id and values, and silver_transactions keeps every copy, which causes both the duplicate keys and the 2026-01-17 volume spike. Deduplicating POSTED transactions on txn_id (keeping the earliest ingest) restores one row per transaction; the residual risk is a txn_id whose status differs between deliveries, which the sample does not show.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts) = 1;"}}
